identitySignals: OUSD Legistar File 25-0868 lists a 2024-2025 Services Agreement with 'Hope Reimagined' of Oakland, CA through the Office of Equity, matching the agenda name and location
hopereimagined.org describes mental health and education support, training and consultation for schools, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category
Website names its founder as a licensed marriage and family therapist and describes a team of clinicians; no legal entity type or registry record could be confirmed
research.notes: Not found in ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer as an organization, so probably not a nonprofit. No legal entity type, registry number, phone, email or street address was found on the website or in OUSD records; California Secretary of State could not be searched. It may be a sole proprietorship or business name of an individual clinician (founder is a licensed therapist), so a reviewer should confirm it is a business before publishing.

profile.summary: Hope Reimagined is an Oakland, California organization that offers mental health and education support services. It provides training, consultation and clinical services (including therapy and assessments) for children, adults, schools and community groups, using a trauma-informed approach based on the Neurosequential Model.
